'''Yael''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] who lived on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'm sorry, Ryso. I don't have any medicine for you today.''" <br /> "''It hurts!|Yael and [[Ryso]], a refugee child.|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]], Yael lived on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in [[Talloran village]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. But during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] began a [[Separatist War|civil war]] in an attempt to secede from the Republic, and separatists stormed Yael's home village of Talloran. The separatists forced the settlers out of the village, destroying many of the buildings and causing them to flee to nearby [[Fort Garnik]].

The settlers camped outside of the Republic base, but their lack of supplies forced Yael to steal medical supplies from the Republic. When one of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Hurd]]'s men fell asleep guarding Garnik's most recent medical shipment, Yael stole it and fled back to the settler's camp. But a group of separatists stole the shipment from her before she could distribute the supplies. When Hurd asked an agent of the Republic to investigate the missing supplies, they followed the guard's description of a female Cathar to Yael.

The Cathar forced the agent to agree to bring her back the supplies in exchange for her revealing the location of the separatists. She informed them that the separatists had retreated to Talloran, so the hero traveled to the village and retrieved the medicine from them. They returned to Yael and gave her the supplies, allowing her to treat the injured and sick settlers—including [[Ryso]], a young [[Human/Legends|human]] child who had asked for Yael's help before the hero had arrived.

==Behind the scenes==
Yael appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the mission "Mercy" on Ord Mantell. She forces the player character to bring her the supplies, and the player has the option to accept her proposal (light side) or refuse and threaten Ryso's life (dark side). Once the player retrieves the supplies, the player can also choose to return to either Hurd or Yael.
